scientific_integrity: Fully specified orbit-graph and transfer-matrix argument; finite Python checks are corroboration, not proof of the unbounded result. Published nonequivariant homotopy splittings are credited.
scientific_limitations: Alternating rational Lefschetz traces and Euler characteristics only; no integral quotient homology, individual rational Betti vectors, or equivariant homotopy classification. Possible equivalent unindexed literature.
title: Dihedral quotient Euler characteristics of squared-cycle independence complexes
